properties.bedrock_type: Vashon Glacial Till over Pre-Olympia Sand and Silt
properties.mineralogy: Unsorted gravelly silt, sandy glacial outwash, and coastal marine sedimentary deposits

properties.groundcover: Dense coniferous needle carpet, mosses, and coastal sedges
